title: Epistemic scope and production use of the ladder
html:
The low-order data are proved: F_\lambda = 1 at q = 1, one-dimensional triviality, and the N=1 coupling b. The factorised form is even in \hbar_q by construction. The value c_2 = -1 is the N=2 factor (1 - b^2\hbar_q^4) read in ladder form; the factor itself is not derived here. The full ladder \prod_{k \geq 2}\bigl(1 + c_k^{(\lambda)} u_\lambda^k\bigr) is conditional on the substrate derivation of the kernel R(q,\xi) that would fix c_k for k \geq 3. This kernel is the open s5–so_3 fibre action, and the higher rungs remain conjectural pending it.

An N \leq 2 Kashiwara truncation combining the z = 1 coordinate-sum single-wrap base with the z = q^3/(q^2+1) eigenphase mixes two distinct loop parameters, and therefore serves only as an auxiliary near-match rather than a consequence of this proposition. The higher rungs matter only for the 1\,\mathrm{ppQ} stretch target; for this target the kernel R(q,\xi) is the same open input required by the absolute-mass F_{\mathrm{Bor}} term-6 Habiro tail.
